Use early 14‑min slot on Thursdays to quick‑brief ablation status. - **Co‑author Workshop**: No rush; keep in mind GPU budget, consider co‑managing with Maya next month. - **GPU Budget**: Current allocation resets monthly. Overnight Idea > **Overnight idea:** *Implement MemGPT’s external paging in the rewrite architecture itself.* > This would unify the paging behaviour across both baselines, ensuring a fair comparison and potentially revealing that rewrite benefits stem from improved page access rather than rewriting per se. ---
